hints.title: Sort Players by Age
hints.text: Sort players primarily by age ascending and secondarily by score ascending.

hints.title: Longest Non-Decreasing Subsequence Variant
hints.text: With players sorted by age, finding a valid team reduces to finding a maximum sum subsequence of scores.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming State
hints.text: Let dp[i] be maximum score ending at player i, transitioning from any prior player j with score[j] <= score[i].

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n subsets of players results in exponential time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting plus O(n^2) dynamic programming optimizes maximum weighted non-decreasing subsequence.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize equivalence to maximum sum non-decreasing subsequence.
